# Mem

Mem is a note-taking and knowledge management application that helps users capture, organize, and retrieve information efficiently.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mem/.

## Actions

- **Create Collection**: Create a new collection in mem.
- **Create Note**: Create a new note in mem.
- **Delete Collection**: Delete a mem collection.
- **Delete Note**: Delete a specific note.
- **Read Note** (read-only): Retrieve the content and metadata of a mem note.
